title: Canadian Cheese Tart
description: A rich and savory tart filled with a blend of Canadian cheeses.
instructions: Roll out the tart crust and place in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a mixing bowl, combine the softened goats cheese, quaint cheddar cheese, and canadian mozzarella cheese.
Add the beaten eggs to the cheese mixture and mix until well combined.
Season with salt to taste, if desired.
Pour the cheese mixture into the tart crust.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
